4.2.rationale: In the Indonesian text, there is no general/primary-prevention provision requiring gender-equality education for the public/schools/communities. Rights of Witnesses and perpetrators

Article 15

6.8.rationale: The Indonesian text provides general rights/services for victims/witnesses/perpetrators (e.g., Pasal 20 on rights for witnesses/pelaku; Pasal 27 on recovery services) and mentions legal assistance/advocacy (e.g., Pasal 16 huruf f; Pasal 23 ayat (1) huruf f).
